away.summary: The Panthers are 2-1-2 and will be without key forwards Aleksander Barkov (knee, 6-8 weeks) and Brad Marchand (knee, 6 weeks), plus Jonah Gadjovich (neck). Aaron Ekblad returns to the lineup after missing two games for the birth of his first child. Jacob Markstrom is confirmed to start in goal, coming off a 2-0-1 record with a .927 save percentage.

home.summary: The Sabres are 2-3-0 and will be without Alex Lyon (upper body), Conor Timmins (lower body), and Jason Zucker (sports hernia). Colten Ellis is projected to start in net after winning his season debut versus Minnesota. Jiri Kulich and Konsta Helenius were scratched in the previous game versus Utah but could return after skating with Norris in practice.
